message.content:
Below is a quick‑look table of the **national statutory holidays** in Canada that create a long weekend in 2023.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the “observed” day is usually the following Monday, which is what makes the long weekend.)

| Holiday | 2023 Date | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-----------|--------------------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Sunday Jan 1 | Monday Jan 2 | **Jan 1–3** |
| Family Day (Ontario) | Monday Feb 20 | – | **Feb 18–20** |
| Good Friday | Friday Apr 7 | – | **Apr 7–9** |
| Victoria Day | Monday May 22 | – | **May 20–22** |
| Canada Day | Saturday Jul 1 | Monday Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** |
| Labour Day | Monday Sep 4 | – | **Sep 2–4** |
| Thanksgiving | Monday Oct 9 | – | **Oct 7–9** |
| Remembrance Day | Saturday Nov 11 | Monday Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** |
| Christmas | Monday Dec 25 | – | **Dec 23–25** |

> **Note:**  
> • Some provinces have additional holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario on March 17, or St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador on June 24).  
> • If you need province‑specific long weekends, let me know which provinces you’re interested in and I can add those to the list.
